aiMetadata.description: Validates a single email address in real time via Clearout, checking deliverability, validity, and risk signals (e.g. role-based, disposable, gibberish). Use to verify one email before sending or storing it. Requires the email address as input; consumes a Clearout credit per call. Idempotent: re-verifying the same address returns the same assessment without side effects.
